                                                                                                                          EASA AD No.: 2026-0015R1

                                                                  Airworthiness Directive
                                                                  AD No.:              2026-0015R1
                                                                  Issued:              30 October 2026

         Design Approval Holder’s Name:                                                    Type/Model designation(s):
         AIRBUS HELICOPTERS                                                                AS 332 and EC 225 helicopters

         Effective Date:                 Revision 1: 06 November 2026
         Foreign AD:                     Not applicable
         Revision:                       This AD revises EASA AD 2026-0015-E dated 22 January 2026.

         Applicability:
         AS 332 C, AS 332 C1, AS 332 L, AS 332 L1, AS 332 L2 and EC 225 LP helicopters, all serial numbers.
